decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission P/2023/2880 dated 29/05/2024. 

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
332/4215d Rev D, 332/4211e Rev E, 332/4212b Rev B, 332/6250b Rev B, 332/4251a Rev A, planning statement received 31/03/2025
and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission P/2023/2880 
332/4210a, 332/4215a, 332/4250, 332/4275, 332/4276, 332/4400, 332/4800, 332/4810 received 17/11/2023
332/4100a, Flood risk assessment Rev F, Noise Impact Assessment Rev B received 19/11/2024
332/4200c, 158028-012, 158028-013, Received 30/04/2024
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - Land quality � additional/unexpected contamination found during development
During the development:
The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if any land contamination not previously identified is encountered during development. A competent person shall assess the contamination, where necessary, including soil and groundwater sampling and testing before any further part of the development that may be affected by the additional contamination that has been discovered continues.
A revised remediation method statement, prepared by a suitably qualified, experienced or supervised person, shall be submitted in writing to the local planning authority for approval within one month of the discovery of such contamination.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. It is therefore necessary to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
Supporting notes:
(i)	Further remediation work to remove or manage additional contamination shall be carried out in accordance with the approved revised remediation method statement for verification and validation before the development is first brought into use. 
(ii)	In some instances, the local planning authority may require work on site to be ceased whilst the nature of additional contamination is investigated fully.
(iii)	The Council requests that the revised remediation method statement or any site photos be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk as well as being submitted to the local planning authority for approval.
Condition : 5 - Land quality - verification and validation of remedial work
Prior to the development is first brought into use:
The agreed scheme for remediation, including any amendments, shall be fully implemented. A verification report produced upon completion of the remediation by a suitably qualified, experienced or supervised person shall be submitted in writing to the local planning authority for approval, before the development is first brought into use or in accordance with a programme approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. It is therefore necessary to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
Supporting notes:
(i)	The verification (closure) report shall revisit the conceptual site model and provide evidence that each aspect of the remediation plan has been implemented correctly and successfully in accordance with current UK guidance and best practice. Where applicable, the report shall describe how any additional/unexpected contamination encountered during development has been managed in line with the revised remediation method statement. 
(ii)	This report shall demonstrate that the development is suitable for its proposed use in terms of land quality.
(iii)	The Council requests that the verification report or site photos be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk as well as being submitted to the local planning authority for approval.
Condition : 6 - Land quality - long term monitoring and maintenance
If long term monitoring and maintenance is required following successful completion of approved remedial measures, reports which demonstrate the effectiveness of the monitoring and maintenance shall be prepared by a suitably qualified, experienced or supervised person and submitted to the local planning authority according to an agreed timescale as shall first have been approved under other conditions set out in this planning approval decision notice.
This shall be conducted in accordance with current UK guidance and best practice.
Reason: In order to ensure that risks from land contamination to the future users of the land and neighbouring land are minimised, together with those to controlled waters, properties and ecological systems.
Condition : 7 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the final detailed drainage design including drawings and updated Drainage Assessment Form, aligned with the Flood Risk Assessment (November 2023), associated drawings and detailed management plan approved on 23/01/2025 under P/2024/4034
Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to London Plan Policy SI 13, its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG, the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Hounslow Council's Local Plan Policy EQ3.
Condition : 8 - No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the drainage scheme for the basement has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components. 
Reason: To comply with the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, the National Planning Policy Framework (Paragraph 103), the London Plan (Policies SI 12 and SI 13) along with associated guidance to these policies and Hounslow Council's Local Plan Policy EQ3.
Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing middle vehicular access shall be permanently closed and kerbs/verge/footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
Condition : 10 - The construction hereby approved shall be in accordance with the details contained within the Construction Method Statement and Construction Management Plans as submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority as part of the application P/2023/2880 approved 29/05/2024. 
Reason: To ensure that the construction takes place in an acceptable manner and would not cause harm to neighbouring buildings or the wider area.
Condition : 11 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than [INSERT] bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed in [SPECIFY LOCATION]. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 12 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public. 
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.
Condition : 13 - The commercial unit hereby altered/extended shall not be open for the admission of customers to the premises outside the hours of 7.30am � 10pm throughout the week.

Reason:  In order to prevent the use causing an undue disturbance to occupants of neighbouring properties
description: Variation of condition 2 approved plans to allow the revision of the front entrance of planning permission P/2023/2880 approved 29/05/2024 Formation of a basement extension and plant room vents, replacement and raising of roof by 150mm, removal of rooflights, alterations to facade and forecourt including new entrance canopy and replaced signage, removal of tree at front, replacement front door, replacement of existing windows in north elevation, replacement of existing bin store all in association with the continued Class E use of the building
